about: Finish song by genre and section, learned from Chordonomicon (Kantarelis et al. 2024, MIT; chord progressions), the McGill Billboard annotations (Burgoyne, Wild & Fujinaga 2011, CC0; harmonic rhythm) and the Groove MIDI Dataset (Gillick, Roberts, Engel, Eck & Bamman 2019, Google, CC BY 4.0; drum grooves and fills). Chords in semitones above the key.
